title: A 32-leaf tree requiring six coordinates for an isometric $\ell_\infty$ embedding
summary: We disprove the conjecture that every tree with t leaves embeds isometrically into $\ell_\infty^{\lceil \log_2 t\rceil}$. We construct a 32-leaf tree whose least isometric $\ell_\infty$-dimension is six rather than five, and prove that every tree with at most 31 leaves attains the conjectured bound; Brigham et al. had recorded equality through 21 leaves. Thus 32 is the first failure, and the example answers affirmatively a question of Fitzpatrick and Nowakowski from 2000.
